fact: LibyaReview, citing an Al Jazeera report, says Libya's last nationwide census was completed in 2006 and political division has since prevented the launch of a new one, as the Ministry of Planning's statistics director also says.

The Libya Observer reports the Government of National Unity reviewed progress on the seventh national population census, the first since 2006, with Libya divided into census areas and preparations said to be on track per the approved schedule.
